title: Circuit Harmonic Matrices: A Spectral Framework for Quantum Machine Learning
summary: Parametrised quantum circuits learn by adjusting gate parameters, while their design shapes the functions they can represent and how readily they learn them. We introduce the circuit harmonic matrix, a fixed matrix organising Fourier expansions over inputs and parameters. It makes the effects of encoding, gates, initial state and observable explicit in coefficient variance, covariance and the quantum neural tangent kernel, linking variation across parameter space to local sensitivity.
